text: The folder clips in my work folder holds raw video clips about AI and robotics technology, each with its caption file (.srt). Make a professionally edited video about AI TECHNOLOGY that is exactly 2 minutes long: choose meaningful scenes and arrange them well, with clean cuts and transitions, color correction and grading, a title at the start and a closing card at the end, readable captions that match what is said, and balanced audio. Export it as AI_Technology.mp4 (1280x720, 30 fps, H.264 video, AAC audio) and also save an editable project file of the edit.
